<reason>CON made the easier comparative: on PRO’s own crisis-command metric, a producing mine under host-law conditions is inventory, while idle rock is a decade-late promise. PRO’s concrete rebuttal showing collapsed into the mitigation CON already offered, so the distinctive work of the presumption was mostly a costlier default. PRO kept a live processing-choke point and a real capture/default argument, but never showed how blocking the only bankable bid creates finished material when a crisis starts.</reason>
